description: Add, update or REMOVE the price-list rows of ONE product — the price it sells at in another currency, for example EUR for an eBay site — keeping its other currencies and its own workspace-currency price. Send only an amount the user stated: never a converted or estimated price; to drop a currency send its code in remove. The product's own currency is refused; change that with update_product's price. A price for one channel only is set_product_channel_price; see all of a product's prices with get_product_pricing. Saves through the same product-card operation as the CRM form, with a version check (on CONFLICT re-read the product and retry), and the new price reaches connected channels like a manual edit. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

id.description: The product id returned by search_products or get_product.

prices.description: Price-list rows to add or update, one per currency (uppercase 3-letter ISO code, e.g. EUR), an amount greater than 0 — the price the product sells at in that currency on every channel that trades in it. Refused for the product's own workspace currency — use update_product's price field for that one. Never a converted or guessed value: send exactly the amount the user gave for that market. Not a per-channel price: a price for ONE channel only is set_product_channel_price. Omit it when you only remove currencies.

remove.description: Currencies whose price-list row to REMOVE (uppercase 3-letter ISO code). The product stops being sold in that currency on channels that trade in it. The product's own workspace currency cannot be removed here, and a currency named in prices cannot also be removed. A currency with no row is ignored.

name: upsert_product_prices
title: Set product prices in other currencies
